headlines.text: Looking back to 2019, when the AEW World Tag Team Titles made its debut as SCU (Kaz & Sky) vs. The Lucha Brothers battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.31 ? a solid showing. The tournament final that crowned AEW's first-ever World Tag Team Champions ? an amped crowd chanted along throughout a back-and-forth war before Sky sealed history with a small package on Pentagon Jr.

It was 2024 when it was title-change night for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as Private Party vs. The Young Bucks battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.45 ? a genuinely great match ? ending the champion's reign at 12 defenses. With the stipulation that a loss would force them to split up forever, Kassidy and Quen overcame Okada's interference to win the AEW World Tag Team Titles from the Young Bucks, who handed over the belts in a show of respect.
On this day in 2019, Angelico & Evans was no more, reborn as The Hybrid2 after 2 matches, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: 2019 brought us this moment: Shanna kicked off their AEW journey against Hikaru Shida, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.57.
Rewind to 2024, when Swerve Strickland vs. Shelton Benjamin crossed paths for the first time ever, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.20 ? a match that delivered.
That Wednesday in 2024, Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.08.
